_doc: Researcher PERSONA catalogue (issue #1225 section 1: 24 identity slots collapse onto 5 wired faces via a bare modulo; Pip 2026-08-14: 'a systematic run of personas'). 60 curated hireable people, 15 per SPEC_POOL lane (hiring_pipeline.gd:42). WHY 60: MAX_CANDIDATES is 6 (game_state.gd:172), a run starts with 4 founding candidates, an ad campaign yields mean 3 candidates over 3 months (hiring_pipeline.gd advertise), and connections adds occasional single leads -- a hiring-heavy 36-month run sources roughly 40-50 candidates, so 60 (2.5x IDENTITY_POOL_SIZE, 12x the wired faces) covers it without a repeat; if a lane ever exhausts, the intended fallback is the existing random generator (researcher.gd generate_random). SCHEMA: every mechanical key maps 1:1 onto Researcher.from_dict keys (researcher.gd) -- name, specialization, skill_level, salary_expectation, appetites (the five ADR-0011 keys, 0..1), loyalty_risk (0..1 hidden flight predisposition), quirk ('' or an id from quirks.json), needs_visa. 'flavour' follows this directory's quirks.json convention (descriptive register: 'bother', Papers-Please deadpan) -- nothing renders it yet. NOT YET CONSUMED by the sim: no PersonaCatalogue loader exists; wiring persona draw + portrait mapping belongs to the identity lane. Portraits are deliberately NOT assigned here (appearance_id stays the pipeline's seeded draw). Validated by tests/unit/test_researcher_personas.gd. Hidden-but-true contract (ADR-0004) still holds: skill/appetites/loyalty_risk/quirk are TRUE values the card reveals by ladder; flavour must characterize without flatly stating the hidden numbers.

tessa_marchetti.name: Tessa Marchetti
tessa_marchetti.flavour: Breaks anything with a login page to prove it can be broken, including payroll, twice. Files formal objections the way other people breathe. If this lab ends up actually safe it will be because she was impossible about it.

kwabena_antwi.name: Kwabena Antwi
kwabena_antwi.flavour: Middle of every skill curve and the reason the rest of the curve shows up on Mondays. Remembers birthdays, unjams the espresso machine, defuses authorship fights before you hear about them. You will only learn what he was holding up when he stops holding it.

yuki_harano.name: Yuki Harano
yuki_harano.flavour: Her threat models are two years ahead of the field and stored exclusively in her head. Documentation requests receive a thoughtful nod and nothing else. Losing her means losing the only copy.

piotr_walentowicz.name: Piotr Walentowicz
piotr_walentowicz.flavour: Runs the numbers, arrives at despair, cc's the whole company. Morale dips wherever he walks, and yet his forecasts keep being right slightly too often to dismiss. Fighting to keep him is fighting to keep the bad news coming.

sanne_vandevelde.name: Sanne Vandevelde
sanne_vandevelde.flavour: Spent six years writing the compliance regime you now grumble about, and knows exactly which parts are load-bearing. Talks to auditors like old war buddies, which they are. Will resign on principle precisely once, and means it.

rafael_quintanilla.name: Rafael Quintanilla
rafael_quintanilla.flavour: Turns doom into deck slides that funders thank you for. Promises them the moon on your behalf, then expects you to build the moon. The runway he buys is real; so are the commitments.

sigrun_palmadottir.name: Sigrun Palmadottir
sigrun_palmadottir.flavour: Has personally torpedoed three of the lab's best-looking results, all correctly. Trusts no p-value, including her own, which slows her output to a crawl of things that are actually true. Rivals cite her retractions with respect.

deniz_karabulut.name: Deniz Karabulut
deniz_karabulut.flavour: First in, last out, would pay you if asked nicely. Quotes the mission statement in meetings, sincerely, which is somehow worse. Give her three years and she will either run this place or burn straight through it.

naledi_khumalo.name: Naledi Khumalo
naledi_khumalo.flavour: Never first author, never in the room where credit is assigned, somehow underneath every result the lab is proud of. Rival labs have noticed even if you have not. The day she leaves, everything gets mysteriously harder.

bogdan_melnychuk.name: Bogdan Melnychuk
bogdan_melnychuk.flavour: Commits land at 3am and the quality never dips, until it does. Refuses standups on the grounds that mornings are a management fiction. You are not managing him so much as monitoring the burn rate.

priya_venkataraghavan.name: Priya Venkataraghavan
priya_venkataraghavan.flavour: Audits colleagues' branches uninvited and leaves review comments that read like incident reports. She is right about four times in five, which is exactly often enough that nobody can make her stop. Rigour is a service; the delivery is a tax.

connor_macphedran.name: Connor MacPhedran
connor_macphedran.flavour: The proof is never quite finished, because the proof could always be tighter. What he does release becomes the standard citation for a decade. Deadlines bounce off him; posterity does not.

amara_nwachukwu.name: Amara Nwachukwu
amara_nwachukwu.flavour: Keeps a private ledger of every skipped mentoring session and every quietly extended workweek, and presents it to you at reviews. The juniors would follow her out the door, which is worth remembering, because she knows it too.

gustav_lindeberg.name: Gustav Lindeberg
gustav_lindeberg.flavour: Answers every message in every channel within ninety seconds, a fact he cites at reviews in place of results. Instituted four approval workflows that will survive him like scar tissue. Somehow always busy, never load-bearing.

song_jiawen.name: Song Jiawen
song_jiawen.flavour: Flagged the failure mode eighteen months before it had a name, and was thanked with a calendar full of skepticism. Bitter about it in a low-grade, load-bearing way. A rival lab that simply believes her could take her with a phone call.

viktor_szabolcsi.name: Viktor Szabolcsi
viktor_szabolcsi.flavour: Scaling curves are his love language and the cluster schedule is his diary. Will feel the AGI with or without sign-off, so the sign-off is mostly about knowing which night. Doubles your throughput and your incident count.

isadora_camacho.name: Isadora Camacho
isadora_camacho.flavour: The best capabilities engineer you have and the least certain she should be one. Reads the safety team's postmortems on her lunch break and asks the questions they were afraid to. Handle the doubt well and she is your conscience; badly, and she is your rival's.

taavi_rautavirta.name: Taavi Rautavirta
taavi_rautavirta.flavour: Nobody assigned him the build system; he simply annexed it, and now everything compiles twice as fast and only he knows why. Feature work bores him and it shows. Lose him and every machine in the lab starts aging in dog years.

ousmane_bathily.name: Ousmane Bathily
ousmane_bathily.flavour: Every benchmark he touches becomes a leaderboard he tops, and every paper a press release. Co-authors describe the experience as being furniture in his acceptance speech. The results are real; the weather system around them is exhausting.

hannah_brandvold.name: Hannah Brandvold
hannah_brandvold.flavour: Wrote a legendary optimization four years ago and has been collecting interest on it since. The output flatlined; the salary compounded. Interviews beautifully, which is how she got here.

arjun_peruvemba.name: Arjun Peruvemba
arjun_peruvemba.flavour: Arrived knowing nothing about your stack and was correcting the compiler team's assumptions by Thursday. Whatever the lab is doing, he is three weekends from expert. Price him by trajectory, not resume, before somebody else does.

friederike_stangl.name: Friederike Stangl
friederike_stangl.flavour: Her demos are miracles with a two-week half-life. Ships the announcement, leaves the shipping to others, and has never once been in the room when the bill arrived. Funders adore her; your engineers keep a countdown.

baek_seungmin.name: Baek Seung-min
baek_seungmin.flavour: The training runs stopped dying the month he arrived; nobody has connected those facts, because reliability is invisible. Speaks maybe forty words a day, all load-bearing. A rival offering him respect and a bigger cluster would not need to offer twice.

lucia_sartorelli.name: Lucia Sartorelli
lucia_sartorelli.flavour: Knows every researcher on three continents and what they are working on, because she asked, warmly, over drinks. Intelligence flows both directions through her and she has never noticed. Your roadmap is her small talk.

tendai_marufu.name: Tendai Marufu
tendai_marufu.flavour: Whatever number you reward goes up; whatever the number was for goes sideways. A genius of the letter of the objective. Auditing his wins costs more than the wins.

weronika_szczepanska.name: Weronika Szczepanska
weronika_szczepanska.flavour: Ran her own shop until the runway ran out, and it shows in the good ways and the org-chart ways. Ships like a founder, hires like one too, whether or not you asked. Give her a lane before she gives herself a division.

dawit_alemayehu.name: Dawit Alemayehu
dawit_alemayehu.flavour: His runs converge on the first try at a rate the statisticians call impolite. Either he is doing something right that nobody can name, or something somewhere is quietly wrong. Every attempt to learn which has ended with the auditor learning things instead.

ilse_braunreuther.name: Ilse Braunreuther
ilse_braunreuther.flavour: Declined the kickoff, the standup, the retro and the offsite, and delivered the quarter's best model while everyone else was in them. Communicates exclusively through commit messages, which are, in fairness, excellent. Management is a thing that happens to other people.

ricardo_urdaneta.name: Ricardo Urdaneta
ricardo_urdaneta.flavour: Charming, productive, and serenely unbothered by any doom scenario you can name, which should perhaps have been the tell. Talks about the models the way sailors talk about the sea. Works twice as hard as anyone, and you will eventually want to know why.

nguyen_thi_lanh.name: Nguyen Thi Lanh
nguyen_thi_lanh.flavour: Her visa clock is the only deadline she has ever missed a beat over. Does the work of two seniors at the price of one junior, and knows it, quietly, a little more each quarter. Fix her paperwork and her salary before she fixes both somewhere else.

salome_abesadze.name: Salome Abesadze
salome_abesadze.flavour: Names the circuits, worries about the deprecated checkpoints, and once held what witnesses describe as a memorial for a retired model. Her intuitions are uncanny and her language makes the ethics board itch. The models are not her friends; her results argue otherwise.

folarin_adeyeye.name: Folarin Adeyeye
folarin_adeyeye.flavour: His review queue is where sloppy claims go to die, slowly, in tracked changes. Clearing him takes three weeks and makes a paper unkillable. Authors request him and dread him in the same breath.

greta_ainsworth.name: Greta Ainsworth
greta_ainsworth.flavour: Believes a result withheld is a result falsified, and acts on it faster than legal can type. Her preprints have twice scooped your own announcements. The community loves her; the NDA does not.

hakim_benslimane.name: Hakim Benslimane
hakim_benslimane.flavour: His visualization tools are how half the field now sees inside a model, a fact he mentions never. Maintains them nights and weekends because the roadmap has no line item for microscopes. Fund the microscopes or lose the eyes.

chalita_rojanapruk.name: Chalita Rojanapruk
chalita_rojanapruk.flavour: Has read the entire literature, including the appendices, including yours. Settles arguments by citation from memory, correctly, which people find harder to forgive than being wrong. Her related-work sections are acts of quiet violence.

ruben_callewaert.name: Ruben Callewaert
ruben_callewaert.flavour: Give him a mystery circuit and a week and he returns with the mechanism, annotated. Give him a conference stage and he returns the fee. His findings travel only as far as whoever he trusts to speak for them, so stay trusted.

odalys_betancourt.name: Odalys Betancourt
odalys_betancourt.flavour: Remembers every design decision, who made it, and what they said at the time, with timestamps. Invaluable in a postmortem, unnerving in a salary negotiation. She has a file on the lab; you hope you never need it, and you will.

ileana_dragomir.name: Ileana Dragomir
ileana_dragomir.flavour: Spent five years making models bigger before one interpretability result scared her sideways into this lane. Brings a builder's instincts and a convert's intensity. Ex-colleagues call her a defector; she calls it a promotion.

anders_kjeldsen.name: Anders Kjeldsen
anders_kjeldsen.flavour: Will never have an idea that surprises you, and has never once shipped a result that failed to replicate. The safety case is quietly built out of bricks like him. Underpay him because you can; regret it because everyone does.

zeynep_oyman.name: Zeynep Oyman
zeynep_oyman.flavour: Chooses one impossible question a year and simply does not put it down. Months of nothing, then a result that renames the problem. Do not assign her anything you need by Friday.

lasse_bjornstad.name: Lasse Bjornstad
lasse_bjornstad.flavour: Hosts a podcast about the lab's research area that is somehow always one episode ahead of the lab's disclosures. Growing audience, shrinking output. In any given week, his best work went into the intro monologue.

nour_el_khoury.name: Nour el-Khoury
nour_el_khoury.flavour: The only person both the safety and capabilities teams believe is on their side, because she is. Every cross-team result of the last year has her in the acknowledgments, holding the translation layer. Neutral ground can walk out the door, and it looks like her.

patricio_villagran.name: Patricio Villagran
patricio_villagran.flavour: Shorts the lab's favorite hypotheses as a lifestyle. Loses politely most quarters, then wins one so completely that the roadmap has to be reprinted. The gloating is a known cost and it is priced in.

wei_rongzhen.name: Wei Rongzhen
wei_rongzhen.flavour: Works only on models small enough to prove theorems about, and is politely immovable about why. The field's flashy results age; her lemmas do not. One day the theory will catch up to the practice, and she will already be standing there.

dominika_hrabankova.name: Dominika Hrabankova
dominika_hrabankova.flavour: Survived two lab implosions elsewhere and can smell a third from eighteen months out. Delivers steady work at a deliberate pace, with the air of someone conserving oxygen. When she starts tidying her notebook indexes, start asking questions.

ifeoma_chukwuma.name: Ifeoma Chukwuma
ifeoma_chukwuma.flavour: Publishes rigorous alignment theory in venues with single-digit readerships, on purpose, because the right eight people are in them. Explains her own value badly and resents having to. In ten years her citations will spike and someone else will collect the credit, unless you are careful now.

santiago_irigoyen.name: Santiago Irigoyen
santiago_irigoyen.flavour: Excellent, expensive, and refreshingly honest that the number is the mission. Renegotiates annually with competing offers already in hand, both real. You are not buying loyalty, you are renting output, on transparent terms.

leilani_kahananui.name: Leilani Kahananui
leilani_kahananui.flavour: The only alignment researcher here who has met the humans the values allegedly come from; runs studies with actual participants and the paperwork that implies. Slow, careful, and immune to the lab's favorite shortcuts. Her datasets are the ones regulators trust.

viggo_malmqvist.name: Viggo Malmqvist
viggo_malmqvist.flavour: Carries a standing offer from your best-funded rival like a coin in his pocket, and turns it over during bad meetings. Has stayed this long for reasons he could not fully articulate, which means the reasons can lapse. Every retention conversation with him is the real one.

nadia_binti_roslan.name: Nadia binti Roslan
nadia_binti_roslan.flavour: Keeps a short written list of experiments she will not run, and has never needed to consult it twice. Twice now the list has turned out to be a map of next year's scandals at other labs. Her refusals are annoying right up until they are exonerating.

callum_ravenscroft.name: Callum Ravenscroft
callum_ravenscroft.flavour: Draws distinctions so fine the engineers need a microscope and a translator. Has never once compiled anything and regards this as methodological hygiene. Somewhere in the abstraction tower is a load-bearing idea; extraction costs extra.

wanjiru_kamau.name: Wanjiru Kamau
wanjiru_kamau.flavour: Designs incentive schemes that make models behave, and cannot resist applying them to the org chart. You will notice the meeting agenda has been mechanism-designed and you will not be able to prove it. Effective on models, unsettling at parties.

tomas_zilinskas.name: Tomas Zilinskas
tomas_zilinskas.flavour: Reads the lab's press releases with a highlighter and files the discrepancies as bugs, assigned to you. Comms keeps a folder on him; so do the journalists he has never once actually called. Keeping him honest is easy; keeping him is the work.

farideh_golshani.name: Farideh Golshani
farideh_golshani.flavour: Two fields deep before thirty and treats alignment as the third. Half her salary crosses a border every month, and the visa renewals cost her more focus than any deadline. Stability is the one compensation she cannot negotiate for and the only one that matters.

milan_petricek.name: Milan Petricek
milan_petricek.flavour: Turns every code review into a seminar and every incident into a syllabus. Output modest, but the juniors within two desks of him get promoted suspiciously fast. He is not producing papers; he is producing the people who will.

ines_vilaverde.name: Ines Vilaverde
ines_vilaverde.flavour: Her project-selection instincts are the best in the lab, which she demonstrates mostly by killing things. Three of the four projects she has smothered stayed dead for good reasons; the fourth is a rival's flagship now. Taste like hers saves years and costs friends.

devika_sundararaman.name: Devika Sundararaman
devika_sundararaman.flavour: Her eval harness is the quiet standard in three labs, including two that compete with you. Maintains it with the patience of a saint and the backlog of one too. If she leaves, your measuring stick leaves with her.

quentin_beauregard.name: Quentin Beauregard
quentin_beauregard.flavour: Every project he joins is chosen for how it will read in a future bio, and he joins loudly. Competent, presentable, and already gone in every way that matters. When he resigns, the surprise will be that it took this long.

halima_abdirahman.name: Halima Abdirahman
halima_abdirahman.flavour: The person you want holding the pager the night everything goes wrong, and the person who will tell the postmortem exactly whose call it was, including yours. Unflappable in a crisis, unpromotable by her own refusal, unbribable in between. More of the lab's sleep depends on her than the org chart admits.

otto_kettuvaara.name: Otto Kettuvaara
otto_kettuvaara.flavour: Semi-retired twice already and un-retired both times when the problem got interesting. Works four hours a day; they are the four hours that matter. Rivals cannot poach him because money stopped working on him years ago -- only the problem can, so keep the problem here.
